hints.tr: `environment: pypi` ve `permissions:` işin düzeyinde, `runs-on` ile aynı hizada.
hints.en: `environment: pypi` and `permissions:` at the job level, aligned with `runs-on`.

hints.tr: Son adım `- uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1`; şifre ya da gizli değer yazılmaz.
hints.en: The last step is `- uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1`; no password or secret is written.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**.github/workflows/ci.yml**

```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: python -m pytest
  build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - run: python scripts/check_version.py "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - run: python -m pip install build
      - run: python -m build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
  publish:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: pypi
    permissions:
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist
      - uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1
```
